name: Invoice
label: Invoice
description: An invoice to a customer, from its draft to its payment. Sales writes it, finance approves it and records the payment, and the payment creates its Receipt.
title: "Invoice for " & customer

customer.label: Customer
customer.description: The id of the customer the invoice is sent to. The customer may read their own invoices.

due.label: Due date
due.description: The day the customer pays by: thirty days from the day the invoice is written, unless sales writes another.

discount.label: Discount
discount.description: The share taken off the net amount, at most half. Only sales sets it, and once the invoice is approved only finance sees it.

lines.label: Lines
lines.description: What is invoiced, one product to a line.

total.label: Total
total.description: What the customer pays: the net amount less the discount, to the cent.

descriptions.draft: Sales writes the invoice; it may change it until it submits it.
descriptions.submitted: Waiting for finance to approve it.
descriptions.approved: Sent to the customer, and waiting for the payment.
descriptions.paid: Paid. Its receipt is created, and the invoice changes no more.

transitions.name: submit
transitions.label: Submit
transitions.description: Sales sends the invoice to finance. It needs a total above zero.

transitions.name: approve
transitions.label: Approve
transitions.description: Finance accepts the invoice and it goes to the customer.

transitions.name: pay
transitions.label: Record payment
transitions.description: Finance records that the customer paid.

access.read: INGROUP("finance") OR INGROUP("sales") OR customer = USER()
